name: Team Aqua Hideout
lines:
It’s an old radio and cassette recorder!
A cassette tape labeled “Bro Special, Vol. 7”
is in the deck.

It’s a well-worn training bag.
“5,000 punches a day” is written in big
letters across the center of the bag.

It’s a Wailmer Doll!
It has a sour-sweet scent.

There is a picture of a boy with a shaved head,
a girl with black hair, and a Pokémon with three notes
attached to its head.
“The 7th day of the —th month, —002.
With Arc—e and —rachi.”
The letters at the edge of the picture
are faded and hard to read...

It’s the Team Aqua flag!
It has a slightly salty scent...
